caption: After install the app is called PF AI: Skip to Checkout, on the Free Plan with a four step checklist. Skip To Checkout and the sticky bar both start switched off. The store name is hidden.
Switching Skip To Checkout on was not enough: a notice says the app embed must be turned on in the theme, and in our theme Add to cart still only opened the cart drawer. The store name is hidden.
What worked was the sticky bar in the theme editor, with its button action changed from Standard Add to Cart to Skip to Checkout (Direct Buy). That was our second saved theme change.
The product page preview with the sticky bar at the bottom: product name, $949.95 and a Shop now button. The store name is hidden.
One click on Shop now went straight to checkout with the $949.95 snowboard in the summary. We entered no details and paid nothing. The store name is hidden.
